description: Freshdesk helpdesk with a documented REST API v2 using API keys.
auth_notes: API key per agent; service accounts can create API keys. Freshservice-specific OAuth page (S6) is a different product and is not counted.
gate_detail: Rate-limit table shows the Free plan at 0 API calls per minute, so a paid plan is needed for production use. Trials get 50 calls per minute; signup is free.
api_scope: Tickets, contacts, contact fields, agents, service accounts and API key management under /api/v2; plain JSON over HTTPS; separate app SDK.
mcp_notes: Freshdesk support articles reference MCP integration and Freshworks MCP security; no URL given in sources.
blocker_detail: Free plan shows 0 API calls per minute; Growth or higher plan required for working API access.

evidence.quote: Where can I find my API key?
The number of API calls you can make is based on your plan.
Please note: For every trial period the API limit is 50 per minute.
Freshdesk's APIs belong to the Representational State Transfer (REST) category.
